chunks: And a group informed me from Abi Ja'far Muhammad ibn Sufyan al-Bazufari from Ahmad ibn Idris from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Qutaibah from al-Fadl ibn al-Shadhan from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran from Safwan ibn Yahya from Abu Ayyub from Abu Basir who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'If a disappearance reaches you regarding your Master, do not reject it.'
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the occultation of the Imam?
ai.summary: In this tradition from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) reassures his followers that the occultation of their Imam is a pre-ordained reality they should accept rather than deny. This hadith serves as a foundational proof for the doctrine of the Minor and Major Occultation, emphasizing that the Imam's absence is a divine test and a known fact among the faithful, not a contradiction to their leadership.
